name: Swetha Holla Umashankara
tagline: Leave the world better than you found it.
philosophy: I build scalable backend systems and AI-driven applications at the intersection of engineering and intelligent automation. My work focuses on cloud-native infrastructure, production-grade AI systems, and building products that create measurable impact.

experience.description: Spearheaded the engineering and production deployment of a proprietary horse racing prediction engine using MLP with self-attention and ensemble models, outperforming industry baselines by 33% and establishing the primary model for 100% of production trades.
highlights: Integrated LLMs including Claude and Gemini with a LangChain RAG pipeline, increasing Precision from 0.58 to 0.79 (+36%) and reducing query latency by 33%.
Orchestrated multi-agent workflows using LangGraph state machines with persistent memory and guardrails across 1,000+ automated daily interactions.
Engineered containerized AI services using FastAPI and Docker with observability and distributed tracing, maintaining 99.9% uptime.

experience.description: Pioneered the Temenos IRIS Interaction Framework using Open API (Swagger), deploying 20+ RESTful APIs to expose core banking capabilities to 3,000+ global clients.
highlights: Executed cloud migration to AWS using EC2, Lambda, and S3 while transforming TAFJ/JMS connectors into Spring Boot microservices.
Developed standardized deployment frameworks using Maven Archetypes, reducing onboarding time by 40%.
Improved production stability through JVM profiling and SOLID design patterns, reducing P99 latency by 20%.
Implemented Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines and improved monitoring using ELK Stack.

projects.title: FinTech Network Analysis
projects.description: Engineered a distributed data pipeline processing 1M+ financial records using Apache Spark and NLP-driven feature extraction to identify actionable market trends.
highlights: Built graph-based influence models for Reddit financial communities using NetworkX centrality measures.
Applied transformer-based classifiers to track sentiment shifts.
Created executive dashboards using Matplotlib and Plotly.

projects.title: Gesture-Controlled Kiosk Interface
projects.description: Built a touchless kiosk interface during COVID using the PAJ7620U2 gesture sensor and OpenCV with a 5ms real-time response.
highlights: Reduced implementation costs by 66% compared to traditional touchscreen infrastructure.
Recognised with a Government of India IEDC scholarship.
